Website information

Your enquiry.
Your control.

How this website handles enquiries

The enquiry form prepares text in your browser. It does not submit your details to a website backend or claim that a message has been sent.

When you choose “Open email draft”, your email app receives the enquiry text. Review the draft before sending it. The copy option places the prepared text on your device’s clipboard only when you choose it.

External communication services

Email, telephone and WhatsApp links open services outside this website. Their respective privacy practices apply. Messages you send to BPI are handled by BPI through those services.

Website storage and analytics

This site does not add tracking cookies, analytics scripts or local storage for enquiry details. The hosting provider may maintain standard technical access logs. No unnecessary cookie banner is displayed.

Contact

For questions about information shared with BPI, contact info@bpibattery.com.
